search, but currently uses a local verified rules engine for zero-cost operation."
Reasoning: OpenSearch Serverless provisioned OCUs incur ~$175/month baseline charges. By utilizing the local verified rules engine in production, GomiMakasete delivers instantaneous sub-10ms response times at $0.00/month standby cost.
